reconcile.note: Gill reads Peter's Acts 2:38 phrase in the name of Jesus as emphasis for repentant Jews, not an exclusion of Matthew 28:19's triadic baptismal formula.

sides.snippet: baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
sides.verseText: Therefore go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

sides.snippet: Repent, and be baptized, everyone of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
sides.verseText: Peter said to them, \"Repent, and be baptized, everyone of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
